title: Solubility, speciation and thermodynamics of Fe in reducing aqueous KCl solutions

Iron corrosion phases influence chemical conditions in several anthropogenic applications. New experimental data and thermodynamic models derived in this work allow accurate predictions of Fe behavior under relevant environmental conditions.
